purpose: Measure the actual finite-archive ceiling of one exact CMIX-native midpoint update before compacting that update into DELTA-MIDAS.
activation_dependencies: Arm B is terminal or the experiment executes on genuinely separate hardware under a corrected host-specific lease policy.
A probability-identical memory-safe CMIX parent passes its preregistered archive, inverse, state, and resource gates.
The P/K/F/S source realization, midpoint mathematics, optimizer write, state rebuild, S permutation, build, runtime root, corpus scope, and economics receipt are content-addressed.
The active host has an exclusive experiment lease and no concurrent substantial compression, NNCP, build, or hashing workload.

arm_semantics.P: The unchanged memory-safe CMIX parent, including every ordinary persistent update at its native call site and cadence.
arm_semantics.K: Execute the same first-half capture, backward bookkeeping, replay, allocation, hashing, and control flow as F, but commit an exact zero midpoint write and preserve every parent-visible state value.
arm_semantics.F: Execute the complete admissible first-half truncated backward graph, one exact live midpoint optimizer write, the frozen state rebuild, and second-half coding, while ordinary parent updates remain unchanged.
arm_semantics.S: Execute the identical F implementation and update magnitude after applying one frozen decoder-visible cyclic permutation of first-half event associations across segments.

synchronization_requirements: P and K integer probability streams are byte-identical over the complete population.
P and K payload, archive, coder state, recurrent state, mixer state, SSE state, optimizer state, context tables, and every future-affecting persistent state are byte-identical in archive-proof mode.
F encoder and decoder independently derive byte-identical midpoint updates, integer probabilities, coder state transitions, rolling state hashes, payload, archive inverse, and terminal state.
S satisfies the same encoder/decoder synchronization requirements as F.
Every 64-byte boundary has a rolling hash over probabilities, coder state, persistent predictor state, optimizer state, and episodic or replay state.
The first mismatch terminates the arm as an implementation failure and preserves a bounded divergence trace.
Equal archive size, equal ideal bits, or equal decoded output cannot substitute for synchronization identity.

debug_shadow.allowed_use: Implementation localization and ideal-bit diagnostics only.

archive_proof.allowed_use: Scientific oracle decision only after all finite archive, decode, inverse, repeat, resource, and dependency fields pass.

diagnostic_250k.promotion_gate: P equals K exactly; F and S synchronize and roundtrip; F archive gain is strictly positive and strictly greater than S. The 1,020-byte value is reported but not required at this implementation scope.

calibration_1m.promotion_gate: F gross archive gain is at least 4,080 bytes, F strictly beats S, all exactness and repeat gates pass, and no futility or resource gate fails.

opening_10m.promotion_gate: F gross archive gain is at least 40,793 bytes, F strictly beats S, all exactness and repeat gates pass, and resource feasibility supports compact-child development.

distant_10m.promotion_gate: On a preregistered disjoint distant population, F gross archive gain is at least 40,793 bytes and F strictly beats S under the unchanged realization.

economic_rules: Gross archive gain is P archive bytes minus treatment archive bytes on the identical frozen scope.
The economics receipt supplies the authoritative threshold; hardcoded values in this policy must equal it before execution.

Oracle code size is diagnostic and receives zero score credit, but the full update must demonstrate enough gross value to cover the compact candidate's conservative package ceiling and transfer reserve.
Ideal-bit savings, separate probability trajectories, or gains from another candidate cannot be added to archive gain.
A result below the gate is terminal for this full-update mechanism on the frozen parent; do not rescue it through rank, scale, layer, horizon, or optimizer sweeps.

bookkeeping_mismatch.condition: Any P/K probability, state, payload, coder, optimizer, archive, or inverse identity fails.
bookkeeping_mismatch.authorized_successor: One correction-only oracle implementation successor at the first divergence; scientific verdict remains none.

synchronization_or_roundtrip_failure.condition: F or S fails encoder/decoder synchronization, finite archive, decode, inverse, or repeat identity.
synchronization_or_roundtrip_failure.authorized_successor: One correction-only oracle implementation successor with unchanged population and mathematics.

subscale_full_update.condition: A valid F archive misses the applicable 1M, opening 10M, or distant 10M gross-gain gate.
subscale_full_update.authorized_successor: None. Retire CMIX-MIDAS because a compact approximation cannot be justified to recover target-scale value absent from the full oracle.

causal_alignment_failure.condition: F does not strictly beat S in gross archive gain on a valid population.
causal_alignment_failure.authorized_successor: None. Retire the causal midpoint claim; do not reinterpret generic perturbation as learning.

target_scale_causal_pass.condition: Archive-proof F meets the applicable gross-gain gate, strictly beats S, P equals K exactly, and all synchronization, inverse, repeat, resource, and dependency gates pass.
target_scale_causal_pass.authorized_successor: At 1M authorize the preregistered 10M scope; after opening and distant 10M passes authorize one compact cmix_obias_deep_delta_midas64_q0_v2 realization.

requires: A valid archive-proof oracle receipt on 1M.
A valid archive-proof oracle receipt on opening 10M.
A valid archive-proof oracle receipt on one preregistered distant 10M population.
The same memory-safe parent, source realization, midpoint mathematics, and control permutation across scopes.
Measured target-scale F value and strict F-over-S causal separation on both 10M populations.
does_not_authorize: Changing DELTA-MIDAS dimensions, taps, scale, arithmetic, update cadence, or injection point after observing compact-arm results.
Claiming compact recovery before P/K/O/R/D/S finite archives pass.

claim_boundary.pass_claim: The full exact CMIX midpoint update contains target-scale causal archive value on the bound populations.
not_proven: A compact adapter recovers that value.
A complete score at or below 105,000,000 bytes.
